title: Case 007: Resending the Existing Policy
initial_request: I have the policy for 107 Alder Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 7ZZ, but I can’t find my copy. Could you send it to me again?
overview: Ruby asked Max at Fieldstone Cover for a copy of the policy already held on file. Max escalated an internal check of the stored policy version and insured address; Policy Records confirmed both matched the file. Max sent the existing copy without changing its terms, and Ruby confirmed that she received a readable file.

next_action.summary: Verify the stored policy version and insured address against Ruby’s record, then send the existing policy copy unchanged.

outcome: Ruby confirmed that she received a readable copy of the policy.

events.body: Could you send me another copy of the policy for 107 Alder Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 7ZZ? I can’t locate the copy I was given.
Please check the insured address and version of the policy copy held on Ruby Hale’s file before I resend it. I’ll wait for confirmation so I can send the existing document without altering it.

The stored policy INS-007 (version 1, issued 31 March 2025) names Ruby Hale and lists 107 Alder Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 7ZZ, for 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026. Its schedule and simplified terms are the current copy in our records.
The address and stored policy version have been checked against Ruby’s file. I’ll resend that copy as held, with no changes to its terms.
I’ve attached the existing policy copy, policy-copy.pdf, for 107 Alder Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 7ZZ. It is the version verified against your file and has not been changed.
I’ve received the policy-copy.pdf file, and it opens clearly. Thank you.

attachments.name: policy-copy.pdf
attachments.text:
Northmere Mutual Insurance
Property insurance policy | INS-007
POLICY SCHEDULE
Named insured: Ruby Hale
Insured property: 107 Alder Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 7ZZ
Issued: 31 March 2025 | Version: 1 (unchanged stored copy)
Period: 1 April 2025 00:00 to 31 March 2026 23:59 (UK local time)
Use: owner-occupied dwelling | Premium: £420.00 for the period
INSURED SECTIONS AND LIMITS
Buildings: up to £250,000 for physical damage caused by fire, storm or escape of water.
Contents: up to £25,000 for physical damage from the same stated causes.
Escape-of-water excess: £350; other covered damage excess: £200 per event.
POLICY CONDITIONS
Report a loss promptly to Northmere Mutual Insurance with INS-007, location, date and circumstances.
Take safe, reasonable steps to limit further damage; keep evidence and receipts.
The insurer reviews the cause, terms and excess before deciding any claim.
Changes in occupancy or use must be reported; they do not alter cover without insurer agreement.
EXCLUSIONS AND CANCELLATION
Wear and tear, gradual deterioration and deliberate damage by the insured are not insured causes.
There is no automatic cover for a newly acquired second property.
Request cancellation from the insurer; any effective date and premium adjustment require its confirmation.
This is the complete simplified contract for this fictional calibration scenario; no real-world cover is provided.
